title: What time to leave for a 2 PM appointment 25 minutes away

blocks.title: Leave at 1:25 PM
blocks.body: Twenty-five minutes of driving puts you at the door at 1:50, ten minutes early - enough to park and check in without arriving flustered.

blocks.title: The arithmetic
blocks.body: 2:00 appointment minus 25 minutes driving minus 10 minutes of buffer for parking and the waiting room equals a 1:25 departure. If the route has a bridge, a school zone, or game-day traffic, leave at 1:15 instead.
